channel.title: The Drill Down: New York Giants
channel.description: Weekly NFL matchup scouting reports and win probabilities.

item.title: Week 12: Giants at Colts
item.description: Sun 11/29 · 1:00 PM ET | Line: NYG -6.5 · O/U 41.5 | Model IND 45% vs. market 27% | The Giants must hunt explosives to win this, and their 8.7% explosive rate faces an Indianapolis defense that allows 9.8%, a pairing that could decide the game. Malik Nabers draws 29% of New York's targets against an Indianapolis pass defense ranked 26th, making him the most direct route to those big plays. Our model gives New York 55%, well below the market's 73%, and the passing matchup drives that gap more than anything else.

item.title: Week 11: Jaguars at Giants
item.description: Sun 11/22 · 1:00 PM ET | Line: JAX -6 · O/U 46.5 | Model NYG 37% vs. market 31% | Jacksonville has to cash its red-zone trips, because the Giants' defense allows touchdowns on 69% of them, the worst rate in the league. Malik Nabers draws 29% of the Giants' targets, and he runs into a Jacksonville pass defense ranked 4th. Our model also picks Jacksonville, at 63% to the market's 69%, and the passing matchup is its largest driver.

item.title: Week 10: Commanders at Giants
item.description: Thu 11/12 · 8:15 PM ET | Line: NYG -1.5 · O/U 40.5 | Model NYG 67% vs. market 53% | The game turns on Washington's tackling against a Giants offense that breaks the fewest tackles in the league, just 3.2% of touches. Malik Nabers draws 31% of the Giants' targets and runs into a Washington pass defense ranked 16th, making him the player to watch. Our model gives the Giants 67% to the market's 53%, with the rushing matchup and home field driving most of that gap.
